result:
I ran all 14 queries against their data files and got plausible answers. I didn't check the numbers independently, so the totals in X3 and X4 are as `qlang` printed them.

- **Key types:** Where a task asks for string keys, `qlang` prints them as keywords such as `:apple`. That covers X1, X6, X7, X9, X11, X12 and the `db` keys in X14. I left them as they print. Customer and department names in X4 and X13 are converted to strings.
- **Optional sections:** X6 returns 0 for a missing section. X14 returns `false` when `APP_DEBUG` is absent. I tested the second with a different input, not just `deploy.env`.

X1: `["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","cherry","apple"] | map ~(lower) | groupBy | map ~(count) | filter ~(gt 1)`
X2: `get /data/users | filter ~(allOf (get /active | eq true) (query /address/country | ne null)) | map ~(query /address/country | upper) | distinct | sort`
X3: `filter ~(get /status | lower | eq "paid") | map ~(subOf (get /items | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) (query /discount | coalesce 0)) | sum | round 2`
X4: `filter ~(get /status | lower | eq "paid") | groupBy /customer | map ~(map ~(get /items) | flat | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | entries | map ~(get {:customer ~(get /0 | toString) :total ~(get /1 | round 2)}) | sort ~(get [~(get /total | desc) /customer]) | take 3`
X5: `get [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(entries) | flat | filter ~(get /1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(get /0 | toString) | distinct | sort`
X6: `get {:dependencies ~(query /dependencies | coalesce {} | count) :devDependencies ~(query /devDependencies | coalesce {} | count) :peerDependencies ~(query /peerDependencies | coalesce {} | count) :optionalDependencies ~(query /optionalDependencies | coalesce {} | count)}`
X7: `filter ~(get /state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(query /assignee/login | coalesce "unassigned" | lower) | map ~(count)`
X8: `filter ~(allOf (get /state | eq "open") ~(query /labels | coalesce [] | map ~(get /name | lower) | contains "bug")) | sort ~(get [~(get /comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map ~(get /number | toString) | join ","`
X9: `lines | map ~(trim) | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split " ") | groupBy /2 | map ~(map ~(get /5 | match #"(\d+)ms" | get /1 | toNumber) | avg | round 1)`
X10: `lines | map ~(trim) | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(get /4 | toNumber | gte 500) | map ~(get /3 | split "?" | first) | distinct | sort`
X11: `lines | map ~(trim) | filter ~(ne "") | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(allOf (get /4 | eq "up") (get /2 | ne "")) | groupBy ~(get /1 | lower) | map ~(map ~(get /2 | toNumber) | avg | round 1)`
X12: `:defs (get /defaults/features) | get /environments | map ~(:e it | defs | merge (e | query /features | coalesce {} | filter ~(ne null)) | filter ~(eq true) | keys | map ~(toString) | sort)`
X13: `filter ~(query /salary | ne null) | groupBy /dept | entries | map ~(get {:dept ~(get /0 | toString) :avg ~(get /1 | map ~(get /salary) | avg | round) :count ~(get /1 | count)}) | sort ~(get [~(get /avg | desc) /dept])`
X14: `lines | map ~(trim) | filter ~(allOf (ne "") ~(startsWith "#" | eq false)) | map ~(get {:k ~(split "=" | first) :v ~(split "=" | drop 1 | join "=" | apply ~(if (match #"^([\x27\"])(.*)\1$" | ne null) ~(match #"^([\x27\"])(.*)\1$" | get /2) ~(it)))}) | get {:db ~(filter ~(get /k | startsWith "DB_") | map ~(get [~(get /k | drop 3 | lower | toKeyword) /v]) | toMap) :debug ~(any ~(allOf (get /k | eq "APP_DEBUG") ~(get /v | lower | anyOf (eq "true") (eq "1") (eq "yes"))))}`
